activity.title: Muscle lab: how muscles are named, explore the models, name the muscle
activity.instructions: Work through the three tabs in order. 1: read how muscles get their names. 2: tap each + on the model photos to learn the muscles. 3: type the name of the muscle each arrow points to (37 cards). Spelling counts. You get a hint after three misses, and the activity is done when every card is answered; your first-try score is what your teacher sees.
